shortDescription: Gather facts about a Cohesity Cluster.

options.name: active_only
options.description: When True, will return only the actively running Protection Job executions.  This value will filter the Protection Job executions data if I(active_only=yes)

options.name: cluster
options.description: IP or FQDN for the Cohesity Cluster

options.name: cohesity_admin
options.description: Username with which Ansible will connect to the Cohesity Cluster. Domain Specific credentails can be configured in following formats AD.domain.com/username AD.domain.com/username@tenant LOCAL/username@tenant

options.name: cohesity_password
options.description: Password belonging to the selected Username.  This parameter will not be logged.

options.name: include_deleted
options.description: When True, will return all details about all registered Protection data included items marked deleted.  This value will filter the Protection Sources, Jobs, and Executions data and return only current information if I(include_deleted=no)

options.name: include_jobs
options.description: When True, will return the details about all registered Protection Jobs.  This value is skipped when the C(state=complete)

options.name: include_runs
options.description: When True, will return the details about all registered Protection Job executions.  This value is skipped when the C(state=complete)

options.name: include_sources
options.description: When True, will return the details about all registered Protection Sources.  This value is skipped when the C(state=complete)

options.name: state
options.description: Determines the level of data collection to perform. Complete will gather all details currently supported by the module.  Minimal will gather basic cluster information but not gather details about source, jobs, or executions.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Switch determines if SSL Validation should be enabled.
